summary: Transport Tycoon entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Transport Tycoon
entries.definitive_edition: Transport Tycoon Deluxe official rerelease for licensed Deluxe route; OpenTTD separately for modern play

emulation.notes: Use OpenTTD natively for modern recreation; document DOSBox settings if using original DOS.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original DOS hardware for Transport Tycoon; official Deluxe rerelease for licensed Deluxe access

primary.version: Transport Tycoon Deluxe official rerelease plus OpenTTD comparison route
primary.why: The original Transport Tycoon led into Transport Tycoon Deluxe, which became the preservation baseline for OpenTTD. Since the official Deluxe rerelease returned in 2026, the archive should document whether it is preserving the original DOS game, Deluxe, or the modern OpenTTD route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Transport Tycoon Deluxe rerelease for licensed Deluxe access, or OpenTTD for the modern open-source recreation. Record source, version, graphics/sound bases, NewGRF/mods, map seed, start year, economy/settings, and whether original DOS Transport Tycoon was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the exact original release.
secondary.why: Deluxe/OpenTTD are stronger practical routes but are not identical to the first 1994 artifact.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modern open-source recreation and expanded ecosystem
secondary.what_to_play: Use if the archive target is modern playability and mod support.
secondary.why: It improves and extends the original rather than replacing the historical artifact.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded Deluxe version and baseline for many later preservation routes.
all_releases.reason: primary: best licensed historical content route.

all_releases.fidelity: Open-source recreation with optional original assets and extensive modern features.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original Transport Tycoon, Deluxe, and OpenTTD represent different historical and practical goals.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact route, version, assets, mods/NewGRFs, map seed, and economy settings.
